description: This file defines a utility enum 'LoopbackHost' with static methods to determine if a given host string refers to a loopback or local network address, encompassing both IPv4 and IPv6. It includes methods for parsing IP addresses and checking common localhost and private network ranges.

classes.name: LoopbackHost
classes.description: A utility enum providing functions to identify loopback and local network hosts based on host string input.

methods.name: isLoopback
methods.description: Public method to determine if the input host string is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Core function to check if the host string is a loopback address (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHost
methods.description: Determines if the host is within local network ranges or special local domains.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a host string as an IPv4 address, returning individual byte components if successful.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within known private or local network ranges.
